comment: Rosé Pine. Source: https://github.com/rose-pine/palette (palette.json, main). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) mvllow; the text is in LICENSE-rose-pine. Roles: text = text, weak = subtle, rule = overlay, accent = iris, run = foam, ok = pine, error = love, add = foam, remove = love, tint = iris at 15% over base (Visual), code = surface (NormalFloat), background = base. Rosé Pine has no green or blue: ok is pine and run is foam, as its own editor themes use them. The list and cursor-line highlights use overlay, but Visual blends iris 15% over base; tint takes that blend so a selected row is visible and differs from rule. No colour adjusted.
